prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: transparent PNG certification badge for Spicylon spice website. Generate one polished circular certification-style seal centered in a square canvas, full circle visible with 6 percent outer transparent padding. Palette: navy blue and white with subtle silver edging. Classic professional seal with double circular border, restrained metallic rim, clean flat print-like interiors, crisply legible typography. Center large "ISO", below "22000:2018", top ring "FOOD SAFETY MANAGEMENT", bottom ring "CERTIFIED". Small laurel branches and tiny stars. Render all text exactly. Reference direction is traditional round ISO/GMP/HACCP badges found on food company promotional brochures. Custom informational graphic; no certification body name, no accreditation logo, no certificate number, no invented authority. No additional text, no background, no mockup, no cast shadow outside seal. True transparent alpha background.
